title: Day-tank transfer pump trip on generator A1 while path A runs on generators
summary: Path A runs on its generator bus. On generator A1 the lead transfer pump P-1 has tripped on its motor overload (49/OL) and the lag pump P-2 was left in OFF after maintenance, so nothing refills the 1,200 L sub-base day tank: it reads 55 % and falls. At the set (field view, GENERATOR, set A1) restore the lag pump P-2 to AUTO, reset the P-1 overload, confirm P-1 is in AUTO, and bring the day tank back above 80 %. If the level reaches 15 % the engine shuts down on low fuel and the drill ends. Fuel time runs x30 (shown on the panel).
references: Day-tank guide specification (Phillips Pump): Manual-Off-Auto selector per pump, motor circuit breaker per pump, rupture-basin float with alarm and pump shutdown (checked 2026-11-26)
Fuel burn: Cummins DQLH 2750 kW standby 60 Hz data sheet, 239 / 391 / 542 / 694 L/h at 1/4 to full load (checked 2026-11-26); the no-load value is extrapolated
Float levels 95 / 85 / 60 / 40 / 15 % and the 1,200 L day tank: operator master specification, not a vendor drawing
Pump flow, filter, heater and time-compression values are model values

steps.text: Turn the lag pump P-2 selector to AUTO
Reset the P-1 motor overload relay (49/OL)
Confirm the lead pump P-1 selector is in AUTO
